descriptionChirho: The gentilic name for the Girgashites, one of the seven Canaanite nations listed in conquest and covenant texts. All three clusters are grammatical variants of the same ethnic designation: with the article 'the Girgashite' (eng the-Girgashite, spa el-gergeseo, arb الْجِرْجَاشِيَّ, kor 기르가스, swa Wagirugashi), with conjunction and article 'and the Girgashite' (eng and-the-Girgashite, spa y-el-gergeseo, hin और-गिर्गाशी, arb وَالـجِرْجَاشِيُّ, kor 그리고-그-기르가시인의, swa na-Mgirgashi), and a singular form 'the Girgashi' (eng the-Girgashi, spa el-guirgaseo, hin गिर्गाशी, arb الـجِرْجاشيّ, kor 그-기르가스인, swa Mgirgashi). The Swahili Wa-/M- prefix alternation reflects singular/plural, not different senses.
